resolved_original_findings: Native PNG save errors, failed persisted Image.load, and persisted raster mismatch set failed and do not append a valid frame. Headless sets failed; empty frame list sets failed.

findings.evidence: The new directory creation condition is passed to inherited _require. On failure, _require calls _fail; _fail sets failed then calls _log; _log calls inherited _write_report. _write_report opens output_dir/events.json and calls file.store_string without checking for null. When directory creation failed, this path can raise a null-file SCRIPT ERROR before _require returns and before the new quit(1)/return is reached.
findings.minimum_correction: Handle a non-OK make_dir_recursive_absolute result directly: set failed, report the error without the inherited file-writing log, quit(1), and return. Do not call _require on this unavailable-output path.
findings.limits: This is a source-supported failure-path finding, not an assertion that any actual capture has encountered it.
